# Maui-SEO

> Maui-SEO (maui-seo.com) helps businesses on Maui, Hawaii get found on Google, in the map pack and in AI answers. It offers Maui SEO, AI search visibility, web design (custom sites bought outright or leased from $99 per month), advertising, social media marketing and logo design. Maui-SEO is run by Eye To Ad Media, founded in 2012 by Zachary Tye Wennstedt. Phone: 1-800-481-8638. Email: info@eyetoad.com.

## Services
- [Maui SEO](https://maui-seo.com/): local SEO, Google Business Profile and AI search visibility for Maui businesses
- [Maui web design](https://maui-seo.com/maui-web-design/): custom-coded websites, bought outright or leased from $99/month with a buyout option after 24 to 36 months
- [Kihei web design](https://maui-seo.com/kihei-web-design/): websites for Kihei and South Maui businesses
- [Lahaina & West Maui marketing](https://maui-seo.com/lahaina-west-maui-marketing/): helping Lahaina and West Maui businesses reopening or relocating get found again on Google, maps and AI answers
- [Maui marketing agency](https://maui-seo.com/maui-marketing-agency/): SEO, AI search, websites, ads and social run as one plan
- [Maui advertising](https://maui-seo.com/maui-advertising-agency/): Google Ads, display and remarketing on Hawaii time
- [Maui social media marketing](https://maui-seo.com/maui-social-media-marketing/): Facebook pixel setup, social and group ads, posting and page management
- [Maui logo design](https://maui-seo.com/maui-logo-design/): logos and graphic design with full file kits

## Key facts
- Website lease: custom-coded sites from $99/month, option to buy after 24 to 36 months; custom builds typically $2,500 to $12,000
- Free SEO audit and free reopening review for West Maui businesses, no obligation
- No ranking guarantees; clients own their domain, website, Google Business Profile and ad accounts
- Contact: 1-800-481-8638, info@eyetoad.com, or https://maui-seo.com/contact/
